text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Having finished eating, Neneka and {0} were once again strolling through the shopping district.
text_block_list.orig_text:
食事を終えたネネカと{0}は、
再び繁華街を散策していた。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should we go buy next? Since I have you as a baggage carrier, this might be a good opportunity to buy something big and heavy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
次は何を買いに行きましょうか。
せっかく貴方という荷物持ちもいることですから、
何か大きな物を買う、
いい機会かもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know. It would be nice to buy a whole bookshelf from end to end. I was thinking about getting a new chair soon too, and then--
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね、
本棚の棚の端から端まで買うのもいいでしょう。
椅子もそろそろ新調したいと思ってましたし、
後は──

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: That was merely a joke. I've never had such an highly expectation of your strength.
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談ですよ。
貴方の腕力には元から期待していません。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: The clothing store over there is having a New Year's sale. Let's take a look. Follow me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちらの服屋が、
初売りをしていますね。
覗いてみましょう。
ついてきなさい。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, for the women's clothing section...
text_block_list.orig_text:
失礼、
婦人服売り場は──

text_block_list.name: Female Employee
text_block_list.text: Oh my! What a lovely young lady. The kimono looks very good on you. Did your mother help you wear it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら！
　かわいらしいお嬢さん。
着物似合ってるわね。
お母さんに着せてもらったの？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. I'll ask this one more time. Where's the women's clothing section?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
もう一度言います。
婦人服売り場はどこですか。

text_block_list.name: Female Employee
text_block_list.text: It must be fun to go shopping with your brother using your newly acquired New Year's gift. Did you get a lot of money from it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さんと一緒にお年玉でお買い物
うれしいよね。
お年玉いっぱいもらえたかな？

text_block_list.name: Female Employee
text_block_list.text: Hehe, trying to look so tall by standing on your tiptoes, so cute. You're already at the age where you want some more grown-up clothes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
背伸びしちゃってかわいい。
少し大人っぽい服が欲しくなる年頃なのね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: No, like I said...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
ですから……

text_block_list.name: Female Employee
text_block_list.text: But... maybe it's a little early for a young girl like you to be wearing the women's clothes from over there? I'll show you to the children's clothing section.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
あっちの婦人服は
お嬢さんにはまだ早いかも？
子供服の売り場に案内してあげるね。

text_block_list.name: Female Employee
text_block_list.text: There are lots of cute clothes here, so please take your time looking around with your brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かわいい服がいーっぱいあるから、
お兄さんと一緒にゆっくり見ていってね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. She's not listening, this isn't going to work. That's enough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
話になりませんね。
もう結構です。

text_block_list.name: Female Employee
text_block_list.text: Little lady? Are you leaving already? ...Did you really want adult clothes that badly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お嬢さん？
　もう帰っちゃうの？
……そんなに大人向けの服が欲しかったのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly. That quickly spiraled into a problem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まったく、
困ったものですね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Didn't someone teach that clerk not to judge people by their appearance?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの店員は
人を見た目で判断するなと、
誰かに教わらなかったのでしょうか。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: The fact that such a half-wit earns wages in the service industry pisses me off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな半端者が、
接客業で賃金を得ているという事実に、
腹が立ちます。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I think that a fake version of her I could prepare would do the job more properly. Ah, I might as well just replace her with my fake copy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が作る偽物の方が、
まだきちんと仕事をこなせると思います。
ああ、
いっそ私の偽物と入れ替えてしまいましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. I've lost my composure a little. If I continue to get annoyed over such nonsense, it will lower my standing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうですね。
少々冷静さを欠いてしまいました。
あのような戯言にこれ以上腹を立てていては、
こちらの格も落ちてしまいます。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I'm starting to resent my indiscretion for making such a big deal out of showing you what "real shopping" meant to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴方に本当の買い物を見せる、
などと大きく出た
自分の短慮さが、
今頃になって恨めしくなってきました。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I'll just have to switch gears and look for a different store. Let's see, I think something that I could buy and use in my free time as entertainment would do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちを切り替えて、
別の店を探します。
そうですね、
余暇に楽しむ娯楽などがいいでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that there are many forms of entertainment that have nothing to do with a disparity in physique to buy. Games in particular are the most desirable form of entertainment, since they are fit for any age or appearance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
娯楽には体格差が関係ないものが多くて助かります。
特にゲームは
肉体によるハンデがほとんど生じないので、
最も好ましい娯楽です。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Also, next time let's go into the store separately. We were together earlier, but we were mistaken for brother and sister.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それと、
次の店では別々に入店しましょう。
先ほどは一緒にいたところを、
兄妹に間違われてしまいましたから。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Please look around the sales floor by yourself in the meanwhile. Well then, let's go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴方は一人で売り場を見ていてください。
それでは、
行きますよ。

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: Welcome! Ah, oh my. Young lady, you're amazing for going shopping by yourself. That's great. Did you get a lot of New Year's money?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃいませ！
　
お、
これはお嬢ちゃん、
一人で買い物とは偉いねぇ。
お年玉いっぱいもらったかい？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Kh, even here... No, I need to stay calm... Um, the game section is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
く、
ここでも……
いえ、
ここは冷静に……
あの、
ゲームの売り場は……

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: Looking for a videogame? But aren't those kinds of games too difficult for you, young lady? We've got lots of cute dolls and Beruru-chan merchandise here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲームかい？
　でも
お嬢ちゃんにはちょっと難しいんじゃないか？
うちにはかわいいお人形も、
ベルルちゃんグッズもいっぱいだよ！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmm. No, thank you. Now, as for the game...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
いえ、
結構です。
私はゲームを──

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: Ah I know, this is perfect for you, young lady! Ta-dah! A lucky bag for children! It includes dolls, accessories, and simple games!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
お嬢ちゃんにはこれがいい！
ジャーン！
　子ども向け福袋！
お人形やアクセサリー、
簡単なゲームも入ってるよ！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...I've reached my limit. I can't stand to let someone like this run his mouth wild. I'll just have to wipe out the whole store...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
もう、
限界ですね。
このような者をのさばらせておくのは我慢なりません。
店ごと消し飛ばして……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: What do you think you're doing. I've decided to turn him into charcoal...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何をするんですか。
私はあの者を消し炭に……

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you done looking? Please come again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
もういいのかい？
またのお越しを～！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...That's enough. I followed you obediently. It's about time you let go of my hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
もういいでしょう。
大人しくついてきてあげたんです。
そろそろ離しなさい。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I knew it, I really shouldn't have gone shopping on my own. As usual, I should've just had my fakes do it for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やはり自分で買い物などするものではありませんね。
いつも通り、
偽物たちにやらせるべきでした。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's right. I get treated as you just saw every time I go shopping, so I usually just leave it to the fakes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ええ、
そうですよ。
買い物のたびにあのような扱いを受けるのですから、
普段は偽物任せにしています。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd gotten used to being prejudiced against appearances in the "other world", but... it seems I can't erase the unpleasant truth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見た目への偏見など、
あちらの世界で
慣れきったつもりでしたが……
不本意な事実は拭えないものですね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Or rather, I can't help but feel that there are fewer NPC conversation patterns than in the version I remember. I'm sure there were atleast some that ignored appearances...
text_block_list.orig_text:
というか、
私の記憶しているバージョンよりも
NPCの会話パターンが減っている気がしてなりませんね。
見た目を無視するものも組み込んでいたはずですが……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: More importantly, to suffer such annoyance right at the start of the new year...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりも、
新年早々この腹立たしさ……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Even if I go back to the store, I'm sure the owner will just force that lucky bag on me. I suppose I'll look for another store around here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
店に戻っても、
あの福袋を押し付けられるに違いありません。
ここは別の店を探して──

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: No, actually, let's go back to the store we were at. Don't worry. I won't burn it down...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
やはり先ほどの店に戻りましょう。
安心しなさい。
焼き払いなどはしませんよ……

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: Welcome! Ah, it's the young girl with the boy from earlier. Have you decided what you want?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃいませ！
ってなんだ、
お嬢ちゃんたちか。
欲しいものは決まったのかい？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'll take one of these lucky bags. I'll leave the money here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ……
こちらの福袋を一つ、
いただきます。
お金はこちらに置いておきます。

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: Thanks for buying! Make sure to come again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
毎度あり！
　また来てくれよな！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, there's no chance I'll come here ever again. Please take better care of your eyes and be more discerning.
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念ながら、
再度の来店などありえません。
もう少しまともな目を養いなさい。

text_block_list.name: Male Employee
text_block_list.text: A-Alright... Oh, that scared me. What's with those eyes? They looked adult if only for just a second... as if.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はあ……
おお怖い。
なんだあの目は。
まさか、
本当は大人だったりして……
なんてな！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Take this. I've bought this thing... just for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
受け取りなさい。
それは
「貴方に」さしあげます。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: After all, this is for "children". As an "adult", I don't need it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにしろ
『子ども向け』なのですから。
『大人』の私には
必要ない物です。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Open it... Hehe, as a child, those items inside are indeed very suited for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
開けてみなさい……
ふふっ、
子どもの貴方にはよくお似合いのものばかりですよ。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, ahhh, of course this would happen. Honestly, what should I do? This isn't fun at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ああ、そうですか。
まったく、
どうしてくれましょうか。
これでは少しも面白くありませんね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I never thought that my sarcasm would be so easily dismantled in kindness... Thanks to that, I was completely taken aback.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よもやここまで皮肉が通じないとは……
おかげで、
すっかり毒気を抜かれてしまいました。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: That right there was merely me trying to take out my frustration on you. By giving that lucky bag to a child, instead of an adult like me, I was merely trying to not have it go to waste and also respond to the salesman intentions, see?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただの八つ当たりですよ。
大人の私ではなく
子どもの貴方に渡せば、
福袋は無駄にならず、
店主の意図を無下にできるでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...It seems that trying to distance myself from you was a mistake in the first place. Do as you please with what's inside.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうやら、
貴方相手に気晴らしをしようとしたのが
そもそもの間違いでしたね。
それの中身は、
貴方の好きにしなさい。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...I have no right to criticize others by making fun of their childishness. I was in danger of falling to the same level as that store owner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……他人の子どもっぽさを弄るなんて、
私も人のことを言えた義理ではありませんね。
危うくあの店主と同じレベルまで落ちてしまうところでした。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Just now, what was that...? Just how much can you... Fine. So, how do you plan on entertaining me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
何と……？
貴方という人はどこまで……
いいでしょう。
それで、
どう気晴らしをさせてもらえるのですか？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: That's... the deck of cards that you've bought earlier. Don't tell me. You're challenging me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
先ほど買ったトランプ……
まさか私に挑むと？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Very well. I'll crush you until you have no desire to fight me again, and I'll make your soul remember my power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
いいでしょう。
二度と私と戦う気が起きなくなるまで叩き潰して、
吠え面をかかせてあげます。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...And that's another close. Fifty-seven wins in a row.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──これで上がりです。
私の57連勝ですね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Did you think you could win even one game? Remember, it's a fool's errand to try to win against one of the Seven Crowns by playing such a game.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲームなら勝てると思いましたか？
覚えておきなさい。
この手のもので
七冠に挑むのは、
無謀な賭けですよ。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: You're laughing...? Did something interesting happen during that last match? Have you finally lost your mind because of how harshly you've been defeated?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……笑うなど、
今の勝負で何か面白いことでもありましたか？
自分のあまりの清々しい負けっぷりに、
とうとうおかしくなってしまいましたか？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...Uh... Hehehe. Yes, it's indeed fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふふっ。
ええ、
楽しいですよ。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: However, it will be even more fun if you become more skilled. So, I hope you will quickly reach the same heights as me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが、
貴方に実力がつけばもっと楽しくなります。
ですから、
早く私のいる高みにまでのぼってきてくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: That's when we'll truly decide who is the winner. ...I'm looking forward to that day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時こそ、
真に雌雄を決しましょう。
……その日を、
楽しみにしていますよ。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: You want to have another match right away? I don't mind. I'll win again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
早速もう一勝負、
ですか？
かまいませんよ。
また大勝ちしてあげます。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Let's play a different game this time. For this game, your objective is to resist as much as you can. Now, let's begin...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は別の遊びにしましょう。
次こそは目いっぱい、
敗北に抵抗してみなさい。
さあ、
始めますよ──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Neneka chuckles a little as she says that, then cuts the card with a gorgeous hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ネネカはそう言って小さくほくそ笑むと、
華麗な手つきでカードを切るのだった。
